policies.label: Base AIDE
policies.description: One candidate at a time, evaluated by real execution.

policies.label: BoN
policies.description: Select the candidate with the best predicted validation metric.

policies.label: UCB
policies.description: Rank usable candidates by predicted validation quality plus an uncertainty bonus (β = 0.5).

policies.label: Sequential
policies.description: Use predicted execution feedback to revise candidates sequentially.

policies.label: Pairwise
policies.description: Compare candidates in a tournament using their code and predicted reports.

policies.label: Fusion
policies.description: Synthesize a candidate from multiple programs and predicted execution reports.

costDefinition: Interpreter attempt time plus recovery cleanup once; excludes model inference, serving and reserved GPU time.
uncertainty: ±1 SE; sample SD of the original 20000 task-bootstrap estimates
comparison: Five policies before/after confidence gating plus Base AIDE; gated and ungated settings are separately run cohorts. Arrows connect observed settings, not intermediate budgets.
